description:
Use when someone was contacted by a person, number, email or business claiming to be Moda, or wants to know if one is real before trusting it. This is Moda's own scam check, the same one on modacommunities.com/verify.
value: exactly one of an email address, a phone number, a link to a person's Facebook profile, or a business name.
Returns JSON with verdict official, not_official or could_not_check, what was matched (for example a team member's public name and role), a plain sentence summing up the result, and moda_rules: Moda's published wording on what it never asks for in a message. Facebook group and post links are not checked here.

value.description: One email, phone number, Facebook profile link or business name, as the person gave it.

name: check_moda_contact
title: Check a Moda contact
